conservative.requirements: You must spend at least 1 hour studying the stars through a telescope of Superior quality. Effect: You see the future. Over the 24 hours after you cast this spell, you can immediately recharge this action to use your knowledge and do one of the following: &+ Deal 3 extra damage with an attack or spell. Turn a failed attack or spell into a success (as if net success). % A Recover 3 wounds. &+ Turn an action that would include you as a target into a failure (as if net 0 successes). #+ Recharge an action card completely.
